section "Users & Groups"

getent passwd | head -n 50 >> "$OUT"

echo "\`\`\`" >> "$OUT"

echo "\`\`\`" >> "$OUT"

section "Systemd Services"

echo "\`\`\`" >> "$OUT"

echo "\`\`\`" >> "$OUT"

if command -v journalctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then

  journalctl -u ssh* --no-pager | tail -n 200 >> "$OUT"
  journalctl _COMM=sshd --no-pager | tail -n 200 >> "$OUT"
fi
if [ -f /var/log/auth.log ]; then
  tail -n 200 /var/log/auth.log >> "$OUT"
fi
if [ -f /var/log/secure ]; then
  tail -n 200 /var/log/secure >> "$OUT"

echo "\`\`\`" >> "$OUT"

fi
if command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then

fi
echo "\`\`\`" >> "$OUT"

section "Time & Timezone"

timedatectl status 2>/dev/null || true >> "$OUT"
echo "\`\`\`" >> "$OUT"
